disabled.description: Shown but not actionable. Default off.

fullWidth.description: Fills its container's width. Default off.

label.description: What it does, e.g. "Create account". Default `Button`.

canvas-kit-stack.name: CanvasStack
canvas-kit-stack.description: The only layout container: a flexbox row or column with token gap and padding. Nest them to build any layout.

bordered.description: Draws the default border. Default off.

gap.description: Space between children. On the root and between modules it is the frame's gutter. Default `sm`.

grow.description: Takes the free space along its parent's main axis. Default off.

padding.description: Space inside the edge. The root keeps `none` — the frame applies the safe area. Default `none`.

surface.description: Background role. The root stays `none`, so the video shows through. Default `none`.

canvas-kit-stack.title: Canvas Kit/Stack

variant.description: Size and weight; the element follows (display h1, title h2, heading h3, body p, caption span). Default `body`.

border.description: A hairline border in a functional border colour.

grow.description: Take the remaining space along the parent Stack's direction.

border.description: A hairline border in a functional border colour.

grow.description: Take the remaining space along the parent Stack's direction.

color.description: A functional text role, a `status-*` colour, or `inherit` to take the parent's.

opacity.description: A semantic opacity role, e.g. `title` for a 90% headline.

templates-screens.name: Template
templates-screens.title: Templates/Screens

ui-kit-alert-bug.name: AlertBug
ui-kit-alert-bug.description: The corner bug that says an interactivity is waiting — the kit’s own (`interface`, focusable) or the broadcaster’s (`transmission`).

interactionState.description: Only the interface bug takes focus. Default `default`.

label.description: Accessible name — the bug is artwork-only.

src.description: The mark itself. A neutral circle stands in when there is none.

ui-kit-alert-bug.title: UI Kit/Alert Bug

ui-kit-close-button.name: CloseButton
ui-kit-close-button.description: The icon-only round control that closes an interactivity.

label.description: Accessible name — the control is icon-only.

ui-kit-close-button.title: UI Kit/Close Button

ui-kit-content-card.name: ContentCard
ui-kit-content-card.description: The tall card for a vertical highlight (statistics, a line-up). Holds up to three zones — Header, Body, Footer — in that order.

height.description:
Total height in px, a multiple of the 8pt grid up to `contentCardSpec.maxHeight`.
Anything else is snapped onto the grid and held inside the range. Default 440.

ui-kit-content-card.title: UI Kit/Content Card

ContentCardBody.name: ContentCardBody
ContentCardBody.description:
The main zone. It takes the height the header and footer leave and clips at the
card's inset rather than pushing past it.

children.description: The card's content — rows of Table Cells, or any stack of kit text.

quote.description: A quote under the body's content. Omitted or empty: not drawn.

ContentCardFooter.name: ContentCardFooter
ContentCardFooter.description: The bottom zone, pinned to the card's bottom edge even when there is no body above it.

caption.description: A centred caption, drawn at 70% like Figma's. Omitted or empty: not drawn.

children.description: Controls or a call to action, laid out beside the caption.

ContentCardHeader.name: ContentCardHeader
ContentCardHeader.description:
The top zone. Everything in it is optional and collapses when left out, so one
component covers the header the card actually needs:

  plain text      `title`, with `overline` / `subtitle`
  with a badge    `icon` beside the text
  a match         `match`, the two sides facing each other
  a table heading `subtitle` + `stats`, the columns beside the second line
  a partner       `partner`, instead of the title
  an ad           `ad`, a tag over its rule

ad.description: An advertising tag over a rule: its wording, and the advertiser's mark.

icon.description: A badge beside the title and subtitle — a flag, a crest, a channel mark.

match.description: Two sides facing each other, instead of a title.

overline.description: Small line above the title. Omitted or empty: not drawn.

stats.description: Column headings beside the subtitle, on the same line — `Pts`, `J`, `V`.

subtitle.description: Small line under the title. Omitted or empty: not drawn.

title.description: Omitted or empty: not drawn — a header may be only a match, a partner or an ad tag.

ui-kit-interactivity-button.name: InteractivityButton
ui-kit-interactivity-button.description: One card in a rail (the catalog’s InteractivityButton): a title, and in the schedule section an overline, subtitle and live badge.

advertising.description: Renders the sponsor row — its wording ("Publicidade") and, when given, the partner's logo.

check.description: Renders the check mark in the thumbnail's top-right.

overline.description: Small line above the title (schedule section only).

subtitle.description: Small line under the title (schedule section only).

title.description: The card’s title — as an interactivity, the only text it carries.

ui-kit-interactivity-button.title: UI Kit/Interactivity Button

ui-kit-interactivity-menu.name: InteractivityMenu
ui-kit-interactivity-menu.description: A horizontal rail of interactivity cards; entering it focuses one card and selects the rest.

activeIndex.description:
Index of the focused item. `null`/`undefined` = the rail at rest, every
 item `default`. Any other index expands the whole row.

align.description:
Which edge the cards sit on when they don't fill the row. The home screen
keeps its rail on the right, over the anchored side of the menu; a focused
rail (nível 2) starts from the left. Default `start`.

children.description:
The cards, composed instead of described — how the canvas builds the rail,
where each card is its own node carrying its own interaction state. The row
then expands through those children rather than `activeIndex`.

heading.description: Optional label above the rail, right-aligned to match the source usage.

items.description: The rail's cards. Ignored when `children` are given.

ui-kit-interactivity-menu.title: UI Kit/Interactivity Menu

ui-kit-label-video.name: LabelVideo
ui-kit-label-video.description: The AO VIVO / REPLAY chip that says what the video behind the screen is.

interactionState.description: Focused: gradient fill with the volume icon. Default: translucent chip. Default `focus`.

mini.description: Compact chip — live only, no icon.

ui-kit-label-video.title: UI Kit/Label Video

ui-kit-main-menu.name: MainMenu
ui-kit-main-menu.description: The home menu along the bottom edge: login, schedule and miscellaneous, then the live program and the channel bug. At rest the miscellaneous button can cycle through several items of its own (`miscellaneousItems` — the weather, a match, a premiere), one at a time, instead of showing one still line.

avatarSrc.description: The viewer's avatar, on the Login button.

bugFocused.description:
@deprecated Use `focusedItem="channel-bug"`. Like that, it moves focus off the
program logo — a TV screen has one focused item.

focusedItem.description:
The one focused button. Default `program` — when Home opens, the focus is on
the program button (Figma: Main Menu › Focus). On Home it is the button whose
rail is on screen: `program` for the rail on the right; `miscellaneous`,
`schedule` or `login` for a rail on the left. `channel-bug` is the channel
logo; `null` when the focus is elsewhere on the screen.

logoSrc.description: The programme's logo, on the Program button.

miscellaneousItems.type: { title: string; subtitle?: string; iconSrc?: string }[]
miscellaneousItems.description:
What the miscellaneous button holds, when it holds several: at rest it cycles
through them — one every `motion.semantic.carousel-step` — the icon shrinking
out and the next one growing in, the lines dissolving, all on the system
spring (Figma: Dinamic Carousel). Replaces miscellaneousTitle/Subtitle. An
item's icon is content (a crest, a programme logo), so it is a `src`; without
one the weather glyph stands in.

miscellaneousTitle.description: The miscellaneous button’s first line (its current item, e.g. the weather).

onBugClick.description: The channel logo — not a menu role; it leads back to the clean broadcast.

onLoginClick.description: Login — opens its rail on the left: account settings.

onLogoClick.description: Program — opens its rail on the right: the programme's context. Home's focus starts here.

onMiscellaneousClick.description: Miscellaneous — opens its rail on the left: various types of interactivities. Focused, it shows the dots of "more".

onScheduleClick.description: Schedule — opens its rail on the left: one card per programme, with its time, whether it is live, and its name.

programSubtitle.description: The line under the program’s name, e.g. its time slot.

ui-kit-main-menu.title: UI Kit/Main Menu

ui-kit-notification.name: Notification
ui-kit-notification.description: The message that arrives in the top-right corner: the programme logo and a line saying why it came.

kind.description: `message` carries the text; `rounded` is the logo alone. Default `message`.

logoSrc.description: The programme's logo. A neutral circle stands in when there is none.

title.description: What the notification says. Ignored by `rounded`.

ui-kit-notification.title: UI Kit/Notification

direction.description: The edge the content sits on. Default `bottom`.

model.description: A layer model id, e.g. `home` or `interactivity-cards-right`.

ui-kit-rounded-button.name: RoundedButton
ui-kit-rounded-button.description: The icon-only round control that steps back a level.

label.description: Accessible name — the control is icon-only.

ui-kit-rounded-button.title: UI Kit/Rounded Button

ui-kit-table-cell.name: TableCell
ui-kit-table-cell.description: One table row. `type` picks which row it is; everything optional collapses when left out.

divider.description: The rule under the row. Default off — a table draws it under a heading, not every row.

favorite.description: Marks the team as the viewer's own (team rows).

goals.description: Goals scored (athlete rows). `0` or omitted: not drawn.

label.description: The stat being compared, centred (scout rows).

name.description: The team or athlete's name (team and athlete rows).

number.description: Shirt number (athlete rows). Omitted: not drawn.

position.description: Standing or group position (team rows). Omitted: not drawn, and the row closes up.

redCard.description: A red card beside the name (athlete rows).

shield.description: The team's crest or flag (team rows). Omitted: not drawn.

stats.description: Up to four columns, each one `table-stat-column` wide so they line up down the table (team rows).

substitute.description: Who came on for them (athlete rows). Omitted: not drawn.

values.description: The two sides' values, left and right (scout rows). Omitted: not drawn.

yellowCard.description: A yellow card beside the name (athlete rows).

ui-kit-table-cell.title: UI Kit/Table Cell

ui-kit-wide-button.name: WideButton
ui-kit-wide-button.description: The pill call-to-action of a screen — text with optional icons.

iconLeft.description: Shows the icon before the label.

iconRight.description: Shows the icon after the label.

ui-kit-wide-button.title: UI Kit/Wide Button
